title: Sewage treatment agent capable of shortening denitrification time
abstract: The invention discloses a sewage treatment agent capable of shortening denitrification time. The sewage treatment agent is prepared from chitosan and grapestone tannin according to a weight ratio of (1 to 3) to (0.5 to 1.8). The sewage treatment agent is put into an aerobic zone of a biological pool. When inlet water ammonia nitrogen concentration is greater than 100mg/L, the feeding quantity of the sewage treatment agent is 4 to 5kg/ton sewage; when the inlet water ammonia nitrogen concentration is greater than or equal to 50mg/L but is smaller than or equal to 100mg/L, the feeding quantity of the sewage treatment agent is 3 to 4kg/ton sewage; when the inlet water ammonia nitrogen concentration is smaller than 50mg/L, the feeding quantity of the sewage treatment agent is 0.5 to 5kg/ton sewage. Ammonia nitrogen in the sewage can be fast and effectively removed through the sewage treatment agent.
